elements.description: A test run that shows only what failed: counts in words over a bar, the failures with their message, diff and stack, and Re-run failed.

properties.name: command
properties.description: The command that ran the tests – "npx vitest run"

properties.name: tests
properties.description: The tests: the failures with their details, and any passed or skipped ones to list

properties.name: counts
properties.description: Totals, for tests left out of `tests`

properties.name: total
properties.description: How many tests the run has, so the bar can fill towards it while running

properties.name: duration
properties.description: How long the run took, in ms

properties.name: running
properties.description: The run is still going: the counts are live and Re-run waits

properties.name: open
properties.description: The failures that are open, by id. Unset: the first failure

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: A failure was opened or closed ({ open }: TestOpenChange); cancelable – prevented, it stays as it was

events.name: tc-open
events.description: A failure's file link was pressed ({ id, file, line }: TestOpen)

events.name: tc-rerun
events.description: Re-run failed was pressed ({ ids }: TestRerun); cancelable – prevented, nothing is announced

functions.name: isLibraryFrame
functions.description: A stack frame from a dependency or the runtime, left out of the trimmed stack

functions.name: firstUserFrame
functions.signature: firstUserFrame(stack: string | undefined): { file: string; line?: number } | null
functions.description: The first frame of the project's own code as { file, line } – "at post (src/ledger.ts:42:7)"

functions.name: countTests
functions.signature: countTests(tests: readonly TestCase[], counts?: Partial<TestCounts>): TestCounts
functions.description: Totals from the tests, with `counts` filling in what the tests leave out (the larger of the two wins)

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
